# This config is equivalent to both the '.circleci/extended/orb-free.yml' and the base '.circleci/config.yml'
version: 2.1

orbs:
  node: circleci/node@4.7.0
workflows:
  test_my_app:
    jobs:
      - node/test:
          version: lts
      - node/run:
          npm-run: build
          version: lts

# Stripe Terminal JS Demo Use this demo app to familiarize yourself with the Stripe Terminal JS SDK before starting your own integration. To use the demo, you'll need to deploy our example backend. Navigate to our [example backend](https://github.com/stripe/example-terminal-backend), and click the button on the Readme to deploy it for free on Heroku with your Stripe API key. ## Running locally If you prefer running the example app locally, you can run the following commands: ``` npm install npm run start ```
